items.text: Understand the difference between scalability and elasticity
Can explain vertical scaling (scale-up/down) and its limitations
Can explain horizontal scaling (scale-out/in) and its benefits
Know what AWS Regions are and why they're geographically isolated
Understand Availability Zones and their role in high availability
Know the purpose of edge locations and CloudFront CDN
Can navigate AWS Console to view different Regions
Can identify Availability Zones within a Region
Can compare EC2 instance types for vertical scaling decisions
Can design a multi-AZ architecture for high availability
Can determine appropriate scaling strategy for given scenario
Can explain when to use Auto Scaling vs manual scaling
Know that scalability is planned growth, elasticity is automatic adjustment
Remember: Each Region has minimum 3 Availability Zones
Understand data doesn't automatically replicate between Regions
Know vertical scaling has physical limits, horizontal is unlimited
Can explain benefits of multi-AZ deployment for production
Know edge locations are for content caching, not compute
